answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can require a refundable bond and delayed privileges for every new identity. Each account must complete a random, independently checked task at a scheduled pulse before earning influence. Reviewers are selected from unrelated history, and colluding or copied proofs burn part of the bond. A velvet reputation badge is granted only after many successful checks, while a plume of fake accounts creates repeated cost and delay. This makes identity multiplication less profitable than maintaining one accountable agent.
